title: Temporal schedules in data_load service (per-schema sync and per-source CDC)
answers: How are external data sync schedules created?
How is the CDC extraction schedule scheduled/paused?
What is the CDC schedule id and interval?
body:
All in `products/data_warehouse/backend/logic/data_load/service.py`:
- Per-schema: `get_sync_schedule` (offset from `sync_time_of_day` else deterministic jitter seeded by schema id) → `to_temporal_schedule` (starts workflow `external-data-job`, workflow id = schema id, overlap SKIP, paused = `not should_sync`) → `sync_external_data_job_workflow` (create or update on ScheduleAlreadyRunningError).
- `pause_/unpause_external_data_schedule` swallow NOT_FOUND; `bulk_*` variants use `_BULK_SCHEDULE_CONCURRENCY`=100.
- CDC is one schedule per SOURCE: id `cdc-extraction-{source_id}` (`_get_cdc_extraction_schedule_id`), interval = `cdc_min_interval` (min sync_frequency_interval of active CDC schemas, default `CDC_DEFAULT_INTERVAL` 1h), built by `get_cdc_extraction_schedule`, (re)synced by `sync_cdc_extraction_schedule` (deleted if source type lacks CDC or no active CDC schemas). Pause via `pause_cdc_extraction_schedule`; does not stop in-flight run.
- `ensure_cdc_slot_cleanup_schedule` = global hourly `cdc-slot-cleanup-global`. Discover schemas every `DISCOVER_SCHEMAS_INTERVAL` (6h). Feature gate: `is_cdc_enabled_for_team` (flag `dwh-postgres-cdc`).
- Workflows: `warehouse_sources/backend/temporal/data_imports/external_data_job.py:ExternalDataJobWorkflow`, `cdc/workflows.py` (`CDCExtractionWorkflow`, `CDCSlotCleanupWorkflow`), `discover_schemas_workflow.py`.
says: External data synchronization runs on a schedule per source
CDC extraction pauses and resumes based on active schemas
Data sync times stagger to avoid overloading the system
Changing data capture extraction frequency and schedule management
Multiple concurrent sync operations are throttled to prevent backlog
